svg.text: pad_ref_rb: replica bias of the pads' reference voltages vcm and vref, one shared bias tree
pad_ref_rb: the replica bias of the custom pads' reference voltages in one cell (2026-11-07, option A of the user's
question on sharing): the shared bias tree bias_tree_rb feeds vcm_rb (S2D vcm = D2S vref) and vref_s2d_rb (S2D vref).
One 5 uA reference current, one enable. Needs ../../../vcm_rb/netlist/source/vcm_rb.spice and
Ports: vdd vss iref vcm vref en_3v3 en_3v3_b (iref: 5 uA SOURCED into the cell, from bias_gen_pd's iref, a bias_dist_pd
output or a core's iout; en_3v3 / en_3v3_b from en_ctrl_3v3). vdd / vss: the rails of the pads it serves (the top edge
that vcm_rb tracks is referenced to the pads' unit rail).
Supply current (tt 27 C, 3.3 V): tree 9 uA (5 uA reference + 2 BP + 2 BNC) + vcm_rb 14 uA + vref_s2d_rb 1.7 uA.
drawn from netlist/source/pad_ref_rb.spice; Xt bias_tree_rb (this folder), Xc vcm_rb, Xr vref_s2d_rb
